basic_info.description: Remodeled 3BD/2.5BA Condo with Designer Finishes, Garage Parking & Private Outdoor Space. This stunningly renovated 3-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom condo offers refined living with impeccable attention to detail and premium designer finishes throughout. The spacious open floor plan features a bright living room with built-in audio and elegant lighting that flows seamlessly into a gourmet eat-in kitchen with custom cabinetry, Caesarstone countertops, high-end appliances, and a custom tile backsplash.  The serene primary suite boasts a spa-like bathroom with a double marble vanity, deep soaking tub, stall shower, and bidet. Hardwood floors span the entire unit, and in-unit washer/dryer add everyday convenience.  Enjoy an exclusive use portion of the backyard for BBQing and entertaining, perfect for relaxing or hosting friends. Downstairs, a large, deeded bonus space at the garden level provides endless flexibility as a home gym, studio, or workspace, plus generous storage options. One-car garage parking is included. This home also features smart home upgrades including a built-in security system bringing both comfort and peace of mind.  Located directly across from Golden Gate Park and a short stroll to Cole Valley, UCSF, hiking trails, MUNI, Whole Foods, and more. Walk Score of 95!
